description: NICE Technology Appraisal knowledge graph ontology. v0.5.1: stable after 5 rounds across 50 TAs (2003-2025). Ready for bulk extraction.

changelog.0.5.1: Round 5 final fixes: added treatment_duration_type (as_needed). Zero structural changes needed. Schema declared stable.
changelog.0.5.0: Round 4 refinements: added intervention_type enum, model_type (cost_analysis), gap_type (instrument_insensitivity), comparator_type (device_comparison). Schema structurally stable — no new entity types or decision categories needed.
changelog.0.4.0: Round 3 refinements: added decision_categories (mortality_assumption, equivalence_assumption), model_type (cost_comparison), icer_band direction field (incremental/decremental), gap_type (single_arm_evidence_only), cross_ta reason (cdf_reconsideration).
changelog.0.3.0: Round 2 refinements: added decision_categories (cure_assumption, discount_rate), disease_settings (relapsed_refractory, recurrent), model_type (mixture_cure), therapeutic_area now array, icer_band now array, treatment_duration_type (single_administration), is_paediatric flag.
changelog.0.2.0: Round 1 refinements: added therapeutic_area values (gastroenterology, rheumatology, immunology), disease_setting values (prevention_secondary, relapsing_remitting), comparator_type enum, eligible_population field, decision_categories (carer_utility, baseline_risk), impact_on_icer enum.
changelog.0.1.0: Initial merge from 2-agent exploration across 20 TAs.

TechnologyAppraisal.definition: A single NICE technology appraisal process and its outcome, identified by TA number.

Intervention.definition: The drug, device, cell therapy, or digital health technology under appraisal. A TA may appraise multiple interventions.

Condition.definition: The disease or clinical context at marketing-authorisation specificity (not just broad disease area).

Comparator.definition: A treatment or strategy compared against the intervention. Comparator selection is often disputed.

ClinicalTrial.definition: A named clinical study providing key evidence for the appraisal.

EconomicModel.definition: The cost-effectiveness model structure and key parameters.

MethodologicalDecision.definition: A specific methodological choice the committee ruled on, capturing company vs ERG positions and the committee conclusion. Highest-value entity for cross-TA queries.

EvidenceGap.definition: An explicit gap in evidence highlighted by the committee, often driving CDF entry or conditional recommendations.

CommercialArrangement.definition: A pricing or access arrangement between manufacturer and NHS (PAS, MAA, CAA).

cross_ta.REFERENCES: TechnologyAppraisal -> TechnologyAppraisal (with reason: precedent, utility_reuse, comparator_guidance, same_condition, same_drug, cdf_reconsideration)

special_considerations.definition: Framework-level flags that affect ICER thresholds and decision logic.

icer_band.definition: Committee's preferred ICER range as categorical band. Avoids specific numbers.

do_not_extract: Specific numerical values (ICERs, QALYs, costs, hazard ratios, p-values)
Committee member rosters and affiliations (except chair name)
Implementation logistics and NHS compliance timelines
Full adverse event profiles (only note if AEs were a key decision factor)
Patient testimony verbatim (capture sentiment via innovation/equality flags)

design_notes.terminology_normalisation: Extract as-is from document. Post-processing normalises ERG/EAG/Assessment Group, appraisal/evaluation committee, etc.
design_notes.multi_intervention_tas: Some TAs appraise multiple drugs (e.g. TA178: 4 drugs). Each gets its own Intervention entity linked to the same TA.
design_notes.multi_recommendation_tas: Some TAs recommend differently for subgroups. Capture as restriction_details text on the recommendation.
design_notes.confidential_data: Set fields to null when redacted. Use discount_confidential flag where applicable.
design_notes.scope_comments: Deferred to v0.2. FAD extraction is the priority.
